d.ko: Lead a better life than your friends in this competitive life simulator! Walk of Life offers unique roles and quirky playstyles to come out ahead! Duke it out with up to 6 players, or by yourself, in this hilarious party game!
d.en: Lead a better life than your friends in this competitive life simulator! Walk of Life offers unique roles and quirky playstyles to come out ahead! Duke it out with up to 6 players, or by yourself, in this hilarious party game!
d.zh: 走进这款残酷的人生模拟游戏，卷死朋友，成为人生赢家！《牛马三百六十行》顾名思义，有各式各样的职业和玩法供你选择！支持最多6名玩家竞争，也支持单人游戏，在这款搞笑派对游戏中削尖脑袋往上爬吧！
